strings.text: The garages behind the nine-storey block, ten to three.
strings.translation: As garagens atrás do prédio de nove andares, dez para as três.

strings.text: The lamp by the garages has been blinking since winter.
strings.translation: O poste perto das garagens está piscando desde o inverno.

strings.text: Shnyr cracks his seeds and doesn't look to the right.
strings.translation: O Chnyr quebra as sementes e não olha para a direita.

strings.text: There are three of them. Four are squatting.
strings.translation: Eles são três. De cócoras estão quatro.

strings.text: The fourth one has squatted down right next to them, in the very light, and silently holds out his hand: got a smoke?
strings.translation: O quarto se agachou bem do lado deles, bem na luz, e em silêncio estende a mão: tem um cigarro?

strings.text: The door of the third garage creaks ajar. Nobody comes out.
strings.translation: A porta da terceira garagem se entreabre rangendo. Ninguém sai.

strings.text: While the lamp was blinking, the fourth one got a step closer.
strings.translation: Enquanto o poste piscava, o quarto chegou um passo mais perto.

strings.text: Shnyr has run out of seeds.
